hook_line: CATO CHALLENGES $100,000 H-1B FEE IN COURT

hook_stat.sub: H-1B payment challenged in First Circuit appeal

stats.label: Other states joining California in the challenge
Fee vacated by Massachusetts district court

diaspora_bullets: Fee is not in effect - vacatur remains during appeal
Confirm the collection position before filing a petition
news_summary: The Cato Institute and professor Ilya Somin filed an amicus brief on November 12 in the First Circuit, supporting California and 19 other states challenging the $100,000 H-1B payment.
payoff: The $100,000 payment stands vacated while the First Circuit appeal is heard.
